Package com.j3d.gen.docs.reader

Class J3DocsReader

java.lang.Object
com.j3d.gen.docs.reader.J3DocsReader
public class J3DocsReader extends Object
A utility class for parsing J3Engine's custom markdown-like documentation files (.j3.md). It reads the file content and converts it into a structured list of TWrapper objects, representing headers, paragraphs, code blocks, and other elements to be read by DocsFrame

The parser supports:

  • Headers (e.g., # Header 1, ## Header 2)
  • Horizontal rules (---)
  • Code blocks (fenced with ```)
  • Inline HTML tags (e.g., <tag src="...">)
  • Paragraphs with inline formatting (bold **text**, italic _text_, inline code `code`)
  • Links ([label](url))
